intent: A drowned moon-priestess glade of dark blue-green wood under frost-silver dead trees, pale mossy stone and black still water, whose one cold silver-teal glow inside a ring of eleven standing stones reads from the high camera as the landmark to walk to.
requests: A shallow basin or well-head sculpt kind: the pool kind is a flat sheet and waystones are upright slabs, so the well's water is a light inside the stone ring instead of a water surface.
A pale-stone run recipe for a fallen shrine boundary wall (new runs are code-side rows this job cannot add), so ruined edges stay stone rather than reusing the moor's field wall.
A soft rising-mote sprite of its own for the well's light; the theme reuses the Ashfields' aurora wisp texture.
